description: This file is a Makefile configuration for building Linux kernels and initramfs images, including setting compilation options, handling different kernels sources, and managing initramfs creation.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the kernel source based on the source type: downloaded or external repository.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the kernel build options and updates configuration files.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Sets up the initramfs image with specific configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules, ensuring the configuration is up to date.

methods.name: Kernel/CopyImage
methods.description: Copies and prepares the kernel images for deployment.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and related files.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
methods.description: Creates initramfs images, handles compression, and packaging.

methods.name: Kernel/Clean/Default
methods.description: Cleans up build artifacts and resets build environment.
